summary_en: This Phase 4 study tests abemaciclib, given with endocrine therapy, as adjuvant treatment for early-stage, hormone receptor-positive (HR+), HER2-negative breast cancer. Patients take abemaciclib by mouth twice a day, starting at 50 mg in week 1, 100 mg in week 2, and 150 mg from week 3. After study treatment, patients may stay on abemaciclib plus endocrine therapy at their treating providers' discretion. The main outcome measure is not stated; this is a single-arm Phase 4 study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 4 evalúa abemaciclib, administrado junto con terapia endocrina, como tratamiento adyuvante para el cáncer de mama temprano, positivo para receptores hormonales (HR+) y negativo para HER2. Los pacientes toman abemaciclib por vía oral dos veces al día, comenzando con 50 mg en la semana 1, 100 mg en la semana 2 y 150 mg desde la semana 3. Después del tratamiento del estudio, los pacientes pueden continuar con abemaciclib más terapia endocrina según el criterio de sus médicos tratantes. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; se trata de un estudio de fase 4 de un solo brazo.
who_for: Performance status score of 0 to 2 on the ECOG scale.
Early-stage HR-positive, HER2-negative breast cancer confirmed by biopsy and prescribed adjuvant abemaciclib.
Able to give written informed consent and HIPAA authorization.
Women who could become pregnant must have a negative pregnancy test and not be pregnant or breastfeeding.
Able to understand and follow study procedures for the full length of the study.
not_for: Uncontrolled HIV/AIDS or active viral hepatitis.
Prior or current cancer that could interfere with safety or efficacy assessment, as judged by the treating oncologist.
